record.rationale_phase_note: One current coded subtype; no assertion that all possible motives have been identified.

rationale_assignments.Coding decision and qualification: Local participants explicitly challenged political parties’ handling of Basra’s rights and rejected their reform proposal, before moving the same sit-in to the gate. The coding is an analytical interpretation of that linked stated purpose; no specific demand for jobs, resignation or constitutional change is assigned solely from national context.

unresolved_issues.Unresolved finding: Propose a qualified political-opposition coding from the linked local sit-in’s own statements, subject to independent challenge. Do not assign every demand from nationwide protest background to this gate action.
unresolved_issues.Next evidence needed: An attributable stated reason or supported interpretation; do not infer a motive solely from context.
